verdict.rationale: There is no documented sandbox or test mode for the hosted API. The closest thing is local mirroring: the open-source package runs LoRA fine-tuning free on your own hardware and data, and needle_eval.py "scores exactly the way the platform does," so you can trial workflows locally before using hosted resources. Separately, GET /billing lets you check limits before spending allowance. missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox/test environment or test API keys for the hosted platform, a non-billable dry-run mode for /generations and training jobs, isolation guarantees separating test from production data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
